Authentication

Every request must be authenticated with an API key. Set the NIMBUS_API_KEY environment variable, or pass apiKey to createClient().

Rotating keys

Create a new key in the dashboard, deploy it, then revoke the old key. Requests with a revoked key fail with ERR_INVALID_TOKEN.
